adultGuidance: Let your child pick a topic they care about, a book, a game, a food, or an activity. Help them say their opinion in one sentence, then ask 'Why?' to draw out a specific reason. Read the finished review together and celebrate the closing line. This pack builds the Grade 1 writing goal of writing an opinion piece with an opinion, a reason, and a closing (W.1.1). If your child gets stuck, offer two topics and let them choose one. Encourage specific reasons, not vague ones: a good reason says why.
description: State an opinion, give a reason with because, write a short review, and revise it.
learningFocus: State an opinion about a familiar topic.
Combine an opinion and a reason.
Write a short review independently, with an opinion, a reason, and a closing sentence.
Revise the review by improving one part.
